name: TED-LIUM 3
description: An English automatic speech recognition corpus consisting of approximately 452 hours of TED talk audio with transcriptions, curated from TED talks and intended for speech recognition research.
citation: Hernandez, F., Nguyen, V., Ghannay, S., Tomashenko, N., & Esteve, Y. (2018). TED-LIUM 3: twice as much data and corpus repartition for experiments on speaker adaptation. Speech and Computer, 198–208. https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-319-99579-3_21

license.identifier: No standard SPDX identifier for the dataset as a whole
license.notes: TED-LIUM 3 is distributed for research use; its recordings originate from TED talks and may be subject to TED's terms and the rights of individual speakers and content owners. The dataset-level license is not a standard SPDX identifier. Review the distribution terms and rights for specific materials before use or redistribution.
